items.name: idempotency
items.title: withIdempotency
items.description: Idempotency-Key middleware for write routes. Caches the response by (method, path, key) in Upstash Redis for 24h so retries / double-clicks return the original result without re-executing the handler.

items.name: webhook-verifier
items.title: verifyHmacSignature + requireHmacSignature
items.description: Generic HMAC signature verifier for inbound webhooks (Resend, Slack, custom partners). Configurable algorithm + encoding, auto-strips signature prefix, constant-time comparison via timingSafeEqual.

items.name: health-endpoints
items.title: healthz + readyz
items.description: Liveness (/api/healthz, always 200) and readiness (/api/readyz, 200 only when DB + Redis are reachable) handlers. Drop into app/api/healthz/route.ts and app/api/readyz/route.ts.

items.name: seed-factory
items.title: Seed factory pattern + helpers
items.description: Typed factory pattern for prisma/seed.ts. `defineFactory` produces variation across many rows; `pickN`, `oneOf`, `chance`, `range`, `aroundDate` give deterministic randomness without faker. `flushFactories` wipes models for idempotent dev seeding (production-disabled).

items.name: security-headers
items.title: withSecurityHeaders (CSP/HSTS/CSRF)
items.description: Middleware helper that sets CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, plus a same-origin Origin-header CSRF check on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. csrfBypass option for public webhook routes.

items.name: input-sanitizer
items.title: sanitizeHtml + sanitizeHtmlStrict + sanitizeUrl
items.description: Isomorphic HTML sanitiser (DOMPurify-based) with rich-text and strict profiles, plus a sanitizeUrl helper that blocks javascript: and other dangerous schemes. Use anywhere you render user-generated HTML.

items.name: background-jobs
items.title: jobs.enqueue + defineJob (Upstash QStash)
items.description: Typed QStash background-job runner. `enqueue(name, payload, { delay, cron })` from any server route; `defineJob(name, { schema, handler })` for the receiving route — verifies the QStash signature and validates the payload with Zod before running.

items.name: maintenance-mode
items.title: MaintenanceMode + MaintenanceBanner + isInMaintenanceMode
items.description: Full-page lockout for maintenance windows + slim admin banner + server-safe env check. Drives off MAINTENANCE_MODE env (or wire to a feature flag). Pair with an allowlist so admins keep access.

items.name: data-export
items.title: exportUserData (GDPR archive)
items.description: GDPR 'download my data' export. Collects records across the requested Prisma models, ZIPs them as JSON, uploads the archive to R2/S3 with a `userId/{timestamp}.zip` key, and emails a 7-day signed download link. Designed to run as a QStash background job.

items.name: account-deletion
items.title: scheduleAccountDeletion + purgeExpiredAccounts
items.description: Soft-delete → 30-day grace period → permanent purge flow. `scheduleAccountDeletion(userId)` marks the row and emails confirmation; `cancelAccountDeletion(userId)` undoes the request while the window is open; `purgeExpiredAccounts()` is the daily QStash cron that hard-deletes the user + every cascadeModels row in a single transaction.
